about.title: Art Lighting — a lighting company in Egypt since 2010.
about.metaTitle: About Art Lighting — LED lighting supplier in Egypt since 2010
about.metaDescription: Art Lighting has supplied lighting in Egypt since 2010: sole authorised agent for Balcom, authorised agent for Mister LED, supplier to hospitals, universities and hotels.

brand.balcom: Architectural lighting for interiors and exteriors: COB, panel, linear, track and strip lighting indoors; flood lights, wall washers, uplights, spike lights and bollards outside.
brand.mister-led: Chandeliers, pendants and decorative wall pieces, in integrated LED or with a choice of lamps.

about.clientsBody: Individual customers furnishing a home, and the designers, consultants, contractors and developers who deliver buildings. The projects below are among those the company has supplied.

about.vision: To be the first choice in the art of lighting — in Egypt first, then beyond — by widening the range we supply and building the organisation and training that credibility and professionalism depend on.

contact.title: Visit or call our lighting showroom in Cairo

contact.metaDescription: Call or message the Art Lighting showroom in Cairo, Saturday to Thursday 9:30am–5:30pm, for help choosing lighting, product questions and project quotations.
contact.lede: Every channel here reaches a person at the showroom in Cairo — for choosing lighting, questions about a product, or a quotation for a project.
contact.addressValue: 49 El Shaheed Sayed Zakaria St, Saqr Quraish Buildings, Sheraton Al Matar, El Nozha, Cairo, Egypt
contact.writeTitle: Start a conversation on WhatsApp — the first message is already written.

contact.projectBody: Send the drawings or product list, the quantities and the delivery location.
contact.projectMessage: Hello, I would like a quotation for a project.
